title: ENTROCUT: ENTROPY-GUIDED ADAPTIVE TRUNCATION FOR EFFICIENT CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT REASONING IN SMALL-SCALE LARGE REASONING MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on optimizing the efficiency of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) by introducing a truncation method based on entropy signals. It evaluates its method using mathematical reasoning benchmarks but does not involve any components related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
